learnings.insight: You cannot 'widen' an aspect-locked, height-driven canvas by giving it a flex column on a wide desktop: useCanvasSize takes width = min(parentWidth, maxWidth, heightBound), and a flex-1/constrained column makes parentWidth the binding term, so the canvas gets NARROWER and (because 9:16) SHORTER than the height-constrained baseline — the opposite of the intent, and it can push fixed-size in-canvas overlays out of bounds. For a height-constrained stage, 'use more desktop width' must mean widening the SURROUNDING content (cards/margins), never the stage's own column. Keep the stage's parent full-width so heightBound stays the binding term.
learnings.action: When asked to widen a height-locked canvas/stage, verify the parent width stays >= heightBound (ideally full-width). If you must reduce empty margins, widen sibling content, not the stage column. Re-measure the canvas px dimensions before/after — a shrink is a regression even if the page 'looks wider'.
